_page_margin_comment: Space left under a page shown whole, in px. The page fills the screen between the book's controls (brought up under the app's header when a book opens) and the phone's tab bar, less this.
_swipe_comment: How far a finger must slide sideways across the page, in px, to turn it on a touch screen.
_remove_comment: How long a book's Remove button waits for its second press, in ms, before going back to plain Remove.
